 "rationale": "PMOS input cannot work: |Vth|≈1 V with VCM=0.9 V. So I use an NMOS pair (tail ≈0.35 V) with a PMOS mirror. Its output drives a matched PMOS CS stage with an NMOS mirror load, then an inverter to get rail-to-rail. Gain is about 30×50, which saturates at ±10 mV. Polarity: vinp↑ → o1↑ → o2↓ → vout↑. Budget: iref 10 µA + tail 4 µA + stage-2 6 µA = 20 µA ≈ 36 µW. The inverter has no static current. Small PMOS gates keep o1 and o2 fast."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak/moderate inversion: max gm per uA)
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.5),
    "itail":   (4e-6, 1.5e-6, 8e-6),   # preamp tail current
    "i2":      (6e-6, 2e-6, 10e-6),    # gain-stage current
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 6.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror + CS device gm/Id
    "L_p":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "L_b":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS bias mirror L
    "wn_inv":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),       # inverter NMOS width (PMOS = 2.5x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    it, i2 = p["itail"], p["i2"]
    gmid_b = 12.0

    # Bias: ibias diode (carries IREF) -> tail and stage-2 load (same gm/Id, same L)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["L_b"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["L_b"], it, vds=0.35)
    m6 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["L_b"], i2, vds=0.9)

    # Preamp: NMOS diff pair with PMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], it / 2, vds=0.5)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], it / 2, vds=0.85)
    # Gain stage: PMOS CS that matches the mirror diode (same Vgs gives no systematic offset)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], i2, vds=0.9)

    wn = p["wn_inv"]
    wp = 2.5 * wn

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.M("MIN", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn, 0.15)
    n.M("MIP", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", wp, 0.15)

    # Predictions
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i2)
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m5.gm / (m5.gds + m6.gds)
    cinv = 1.0e-15 * (wn + wp) * 0.15 / 0.15 * 1.0 + 0.5e-15 * (wn + wp)
    c1 = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg + m5.cgd * min(a2, 20)
    c2 = m5.cdd + m6.cdd + cinv
    di1 = min(m1.gm * 2 * vod, it)              # differential current for a 2*VOD input step
    dv1 = 0.45 / max(a2, 1)                     # o1 swing needed to slew o2 through mid-rail
    t1 = c1 * max(dv1, 0.03) / di1 + c1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds) * 0.0
    t2 = c2 * 0.9 / i2
    ron = 1.0 / (lut.op("n", wn, 0.15, 1.8, 0.9)["Id"] / 0.9 + 1e-12)
    t3 = 0.69 * ron * (cl + 2e-15)
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "gain_db": db(a1 * a2)}
